cross-reference.answer: I read §2002:9.2.3. The CRT status values (0000, 1xxx, 2xxx, 8000, 8001, 9xxx) and the 9xxx sentence ('An implementor-defined condition exists. The numeric value xxx is defined by the implementor') are the same as 2023's. 2023 drops only 2002's introductory four-condition summary, which restates the same list. Scope is unchanged. The screen facility is declined at --std 2002 under §2002:B.3 item 1 with §2002:3.1.5 (the reader's licence-2002), so nothing a 2002 program can show changes.
